opening.argument: The sponsored crypto promotions tie participation in named token projects to concrete financial benefits. One banner promotes withdrawing BUSD or compounding for more THOREUM while displaying a 13% tax-free claim, and another connects a crypto project with “MAXIMIZING PROFITS.” Those are appreciation or passive-income appeals associated with holding or participating in the token project. The PancakeSwap material does not establish that any destination was fraudulent: the speaker instead focuses on stale API pricing, stating that “PancakeSwap has an API that doesn't return the price in real time.” The speaker also gives a trading caution, saying “if you going to make trade you can remember this about the library,” and the discussion is framed as technical analysis rather than evidence of a completed trade.
